config_logging: configure the root logger with a custom format, level, and LocalsFormatter for exception stack traces
get_logger: get a configured logger instance at the specified logging level for use in your module
log_heading: log a visually distinct heading with separator lines and ANSI color styling to the logger
get_separator: get a text separator string of dashes with a configurable length for log formatting
LocalsFormatter: use the LocalsFormatter class to show local variables in exception traceback stack dumps
